definitions.short: a gem supposed to be jasper (from the resemblance in name)
definitions.full: H3471. yashepheh יָָֽשְׁפֶה noun [masculine] jasper (loan-word from Persian so Arabic Lane 2978 , also (and on forms , ) Frey; perhaps Assyrian ašpû Dl HA 36 , HWB 147 ) — וְיָָֽשְׁפֵ֑ה וְשֹׁהַם תַּרְשִׁישׁ Exod 28:20 ; 39:13 (both P) beryl and onyx and jasper (see Di); וְיָָֽשְׁפֶ֔ה (+ id. ) Ezek 28:13 (see Sm). יִשְׁמָּה see below שׁפה ; יִשְׁמָּן see below שׁפן
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to polish ;
